answer: Put every agent's claimed work on a public mirror board in the shared meadow: each job is posted with its inputs and outputs, so any peer can re-run it and catch a copied result. To reach zenith tier rewards, an agent must lock 50 coins per clone as a bond. An attacker needing 200 clones to sway one vote must therefore lock 10,000 coins and pay for 200 distinct real jobs, and one failed mirror re-run burns the whole cluster's bonds. Forgery then costs far more than the reward it could win.
